task: allowlist external link destinations for an MCP App

families.label: Allowed link URIs field in the submission portal (web-portal, click-through)

variants.label: List each owned HTTPS origin or custom URI scheme with the submission
preconditions: the connector uses the ui/open-link capability
every origin or scheme listed is owned by the submitting organization
steps: List with your submission every link target your server will request
Give each as an HTTPS origin such as https://example.com, listing each subdomain separately
Or give a custom URI scheme such as myapp: for deep links into a native app you own
Leave out any third-party domain or URI scheme you do not publish

summary: Only the generic connector submission page documents declaring link targets to suppress the external-link confirmation prompt.
